verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments API platform (not an agent itself), so publishing an official MCP server is a valid axis; evidence shows a documented official MCP server endpoint at docs.mangopay.com/_mcp/server alongside llms.txt and OpenAPI probes confirming AI-native tooling support. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of connecting an agent to this MCP server, and no detail on its tool coverage or setup docs beyond the endpoint existing.
